descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S19 Production model IDs and guardrail match the UAT run record

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 The guardrail configuration (ADDRESS/PHONE = None) and the model ID are version-pinned in production and match what UAT ran on. (UAT OAT-05; UAT 3.1; TFA-94059 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress
  • U9 Each run records which AI ran each step: the note model, the speech-to-text engine (GPT-Live streaming; Deepgram only when ambient is on), and the models for pre-round processing, photo capture and A … (UAT 3.9; UAT 3.1; TFA-94423 AC 7)
  • U3b GPT-live is the active dictation engine on production: aiProvider.transcription is 'gpt-live' (not missing, not 'whisper'). (TFA-94423 AC 1; TFA-94423 notes (Daniela 2026-10-09: 'GPT-live only'))

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given The 3.1/3.9 run record of the UAT run, and the same values read on production by Tim

When Compare field by field, as exact strings. aiProvider:_current (provider, model, fallbackModel, visionProvider, visionModel, transcription); BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_ID and BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_VERSION; the guardrail's PII actions (S20); the VERTEX_AI_CONFIG project, location and model; the deployed commit. …

Then Every field equals the 3.1/3.9 run record exactly. Production aiProvider.transcription is 'gpt-live', whatever the record says. No aiProvider change has been made since the UAT run.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-05 step 7 'match what UAT ran on', TFA-94059 AC 6 and UAT 3.1. Judged on exact string equality with the run record for every field: any difference is a Fail, quoted with the field and both values. U3b is absolute (TFA-94423 AC 1, Daniela 2026-10-09 'GPT-live only'): a missing transcription value or 'whisper' on production is a Fail, quoted with the row, even if the UAT …

Where it ran: dev; test method CONFIG · Config check; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-05.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: CONFIG · Config check; secondary: DOC · Document check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
